evidence.reason: The code merges positive and negative workspace patterns from both package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml before globbing. Exclusions from package.json are therefore applied to members included only by pnpm-workspace.yaml, even though pnpm does not use package.json workspaces. A package excluded by npm in package.json but included by pnpm can be dropped from the member comparison, allowing dependency changes to escape validation. This is an ordinary correctness defect; scoping each declaration's exclusions to its own include set fixes it without changing intended scope.
